name: mima-labs-website
description: Typed localized static website for MIMA LABS

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && esbuild src/build/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --outfile=.generated/build.mjs && esbuild src/client/index.ts --bundle --format=iife --target=es2020 --minify --outfile=site/assets/site.js && node .generated/build.mjs
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test tools/qa/support.test.mjs && python3 tools/qa_static.py && node tools/qa_seo_v7.mjs && node tools/qa_navigation_v7.mjs && node tools/qa_interactions_v7.mjs && node tools/qa_return_navigation_v7.mjs && node tools/qa_catalog_growth_v7.mjs && node tools/qa_views_v8.mjs
